benefit: Financial income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred into the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of landholding farmer families.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names. Requires e-KYC, Aadhaar seeded bank account, and land seeding.

benefit: Comprehensive crop loss insurance coverage from pre-sowing to post-harvest against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rainfall, hailstorm, pest epidemics).
premium_rates: Farmer pays minimal premium: maximum 2% of sum insured for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops. Remaining actuarial premium is subsidized equally by Central and State Governments.
claim_procedure: In case of localized disaster or post-harvest loss, farmer must report within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App, toll-free helpline, or bank/agriculture office.

benefit: Provides farmers with crop-wise nutrient status and dosage recommendations for 12 parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) every 3 years to curb over-fertilization.

scheme: PMKSY (Per Drop More Crop - Micro Irrigation)
benefit: Capital subsidy (up to 55% for small/marginal farmers, 45% for other farmers) for installation of Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems.
